snippet.title: Serpico – Official Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
👉 Try the playtest on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3858580/Serpico/

⚠️ This is a very early and rough build – expect bugs, jank, and unfinished features. Your feedback is critical and will directly shape the future of Serpico.

📝 Share your thoughts and report bugs in the Discord:
https://discord.gg/srh2acjFgh

Thanks for supporting Serpico's development!
